thread:
Anika: hey team 1 putting this in thread bc it's sensitive. i've been having unpredictable autoimmune flares that sometimes make me bedbound for a day or two. asking for: 1) ability to take intermittent remote sick days without using PTO, 2) an ergonomic chair request approved asap, 3) no back-to-back interview panels for 8 weeks (i do interviews and it's exhausting). also worried about my midcycle calibration coming up. advice?

Leo - Manager: Anika 1 i'm really sorry you're dealing with this. yes we can do remote sick days and cover interviews. please don't worry about calibration; we'll work with People Ops to make sure it's fair. i can take over interviews this cycle if needed.

Sam - People Ops: hi Anika 1 thanks for flagging. our standard options: a time-bound accommodation letter (e.g., 8-12 weeks) documenting remote sick days, approved equipment (ergonomic chair via facilities), and interview duty adjustments. we mark the accommodation confidential and only note factual changes to duties in the HR system. want to set a 20m private call today?

Anika: yes to the call. i don't have a provider note at the moment but can get one later if needed. prefer minimal manager detail beyond "temporary schedule/equipment accommodations".

Ivy - HR: provider note optional but helpful. for calibration we'll either reweight deliverables or shift the review window based on the accommodation timeline. we do not add subjective statements to reviews.

Kara - Recruiting: we can adjust panels and assign backups for 8 weeks. i can also create interview slots that are single 45m blocks with breaks between.

Sam - People Ops: draft template we can sign today:

```
Temporary Accommodation (draft):
- Remote sick days: intermittent paid remote sick days for up to 2 days/month for 12 weeks
- Equipment: expedite ergonomic chair shipment and priority desk assessment
- Interview duties: limit to max 1 panel/day; provide backup interviewer coverage for 8 weeks
- Performance: offer review reweighting or 3-month extension if flares materially affect output
- Privacy: accommodation recorded in confidential HR file; manager notes limited to scope and dates
```

Sam - People Ops: if that looks good i'll file it and coordinate facilities + recruiting. we'll leave calibration notes factual only.

Anika: that reads well. appreciate the fast response. i'll take the call at 3pm.

Leo - Manager: calling out i'll cover any urgent customer issues while you're recovering. thanks for telling us.

Sam - People Ops: DM'ing invite now. all sensitive health info stays in HR records. :lock:
